key_highlights: ASX closed volatile week higher, with bank stocks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) providing key support amid Wall Street inflation-driven selloff
Iron ore prices rising ('roaches seeth'), supporting BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; Middle East/Hormuz tensions lifting oil and energy names
Aussie interest rate expectations rocketing, with mortgage rates edging higher; 72% of homebuyers paused searches awaiting lower rates
Australian home values declined sharply in August; auction sentiment deteriorating — signals potential housing correction
Star Entertainment (SGH.AX) bled $307m with auditors questioning survival; casino sector under regulatory pressure
Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech defied political pressure, reinforcing global rate-hike bias
Australia imposing 'high bar' on fossil-fuel-powered data centres, impacting energy transition and tech infrastructure
Gateway Resources (GAT.AX) added 7km gold trend in WA; ASX small-caps X2M, Discovery Alaska, Metal Hawk, Bapcor led weekly gains

sectors.trend: Iron ore prices firming; gold exploration positive with Gateway's WA discovery. Commodity tailwind from Middle East risk premium.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from iron ore strength. GAT.AX and gold juniors see speculative interest. Watch for China demand signals.

sectors.trend: Bank stocks anchored ASX higher as global equities slid on inflation fears. Rising rate expectations support NIM but pressure credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX remain defensive anchors. Higher-for-longer rates boost earnings but housing stress could elevate NPLs.

sectors.trend: Oil rising on Middle East/Hormuz tensions. Virgin (QAN.AX) shielded by fuel hedging. Oil giants retreating from clean energy commitments.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil premium. QAN.AX insulated short-term. Clean-energy retreat signals slower transition capex.

sectors.trend: Home values declining sharply; auction sentiment deteriorating; 72% of buyers paused. Housing crash narrative gaining traction.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICOL.AX) face occupancy and valuation pressure. Construction and home-loan exposure at risk. Insurer shortfalls add stress.

sectors.trend: Grocery prices stubbornly high; major fruit grower cutting ~1,000 jobs; EV uptake and weight-loss drug demand accelerating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. CSL.AX benefits from weight-loss drug demand. EV adoption supports long-term energy transition.

sectors.trend: Star Entertainment in distress; Screen Queensland funding cut; data-centre fossil-fuel restrictions; global tech (Nvidia, CrowdStrike) strong.
sectors.implications: SGH.AX at existential risk. Domestic tech/entertainment underfunded. Global tech strength (NVDA, CRWD) supports ASX tech proxies.

key_themes: Rising rate expectations and inflation stickiness pressuring housing and rate-sensitive sectors
Geopolitical risk (Hormuz, Middle East) lifting oil and defence-related equities
Housing market deterioration: falling values, paused buyer activity, auction weakness
Commodity strength (iron ore, oil, gold) supporting materials and energy
Regulatory pressure on casinos and fossil-fuel data centres reshaping sector dynamics
Global inflation narrative (US grocery +5.9%, Fed hawkish) feeding through to AUD and RBA expectations

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; favour banks with strong capital buffers (CBA.AX, NAB.AX); monitor NPL trends
Hedge energy exposure; favour fuel-hedged names (QAN.AX); monitor Brent/WTI and AUD/USD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / rising rate expectations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shift duration risk; favour floating-rate and dividend-paying equities; avoid rate-sensitive REITs
Avoid SGH.AX; monitor regulatory developments; assess peer contagion to gaming names
Diversify across sectors; monitor policy shifts on data centres, immigration, and housing

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight iron ore and gold miners on commodity strength
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore firming; Gateway's WA gold discovery boosts sector sentiment; Middle East risk premium supports metals

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap banks as defensive anchors
opportunities.rationale: Banks supported ASX through global selloff; rising rates boost NIM; strong capital positions

opportunities.recommendation: Selective energy exposure via fuel-hedged operators
opportunities.rationale: Oil rising on Hormuz risk; QAN.AX insulated by hedging and new fleet; WDS.AX benefits from LNG/oil premium

opportunities.recommendation: CSL.AX on weight-loss drug demand tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Accelerating weight-loss drug uptake in Australia; CSL's diversified healthcare pipeline de-risks single-product exposure

defensive_moves.rationale: Sharp home value decline, auction weakness, 72% buyer pause signal prolonged housing downturn; insurer shortfalls add stress

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid SGH.AX and monitor casino sector contagion
defensive_moves.rationale: $307m loss, auditor doubts on survival, regulatory fury from operators; existential risk to Star
Rising rate expectations and hawkish Fed (Warsh) pressure AUD; inflation stickiness in grocery prices limits RBA easing

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain volatile. Banks and miners provide floor support, but housing weakness, rising rate expectations, and Middle East oil risk cap upside. Expect range-bound trading with sector rotation toward defensives and commodities.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Housing correction may deepen, pressuring REITs and construction. Commodity cycle (iron ore, oil, gold) supports materials/energy. RBA constrained by sticky inflation. Structural themes: EV adoption, weight-loss drugs, automation reducing immigration need. Political uncertainty adds policy risk.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
Iron ore and oil price trajectory (Hormuz situation)
Australian housing data (home values, auction clearance, buyer sentiment)
US inflation data and Fed Warsh policy path
Star Entertainment auditor outcome and regulatory response
WA by-election and federal political dynamics
watch_list: Iron ore (62% Fe) spot and futures pricing
CPI and retail sales data (September release)
GAT.AX and small-cap miners (X2M, Metal Hawk, Bapcor) momentum
QAN.AX fuel hedge effectiveness vs oil moves
US grocery inflation (5.9% cited) and global inflation spillover
